criteria.reason: The 60-file implementation/final-documentation diff stays inside Accounts/Identity and approved seams; Phase 0 and Phase 2 product behavior are unchanged.
The independent architecture gate reports zero violations and the reviewed dependency direction is coherent.
Account, identity, document, claim, case, evidence, review, and enrollment operation remain distinct owned concepts.
Entity and evidence IDs generated by the product path are opaque UUIDv7 values.
The base Account is role-neutral and no future role feature was introduced.
The Account domain transition matrix and terminal CLOSED behavior are exhaustive; the physical-role bypass is assessed under AC-008 and AC-025.
PostgreSQL accepts an identity review whose evidence belongs to a different verification case and identity, then accepts establishment using that invalid combination.
A physical runtime login can manufacture actor/evidence rows, activate the aggregate, and omit the required activation outbox events.
Terminal states cannot be reopened and blocking claims cannot be silently released through tested lifecycle edges.
The exact do-cedula-v1 scalar, removal, Unicode, ASCII-digit, length, and idempotence contract passes.
Formatting, structural assessment, and trusted verification remain separate types; formatting alone cannot activate.
The exact domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 vector reproduces.
Scope, key/version, value, separator, and encoding mutations change the fingerprint.
No plaintext, unkeyed digest, or HMAC key is persisted or used as the uniqueness mechanism.
AES-256-GCM/AAD vector, round trip, and tampering matrix fail closed as required.
The same raw 256-bit material is accepted simultaneously as fingerprint HMAC key, KEK, and idempotency key without detection.
Disjoint old/new writers create duplicate aggregates, and no declared least-privilege database role can execute the retained rotation stores.
Repository, error, event, and downloaded-artifact scans expose no restricted document or cryptographic material.
Migration hashes are unchanged and clean/repeat/down/up/populated-refusal/concurrent behavior passes.
PostgreSQL still enforces one identity per account and the literal established-identity plus bound-claim activation prerequisite.
The partial unique index covers every blocking alias over the declared complete per-key-version scope.
The seven mutation checkpoints roll back account, identity, document, aliases, transitions, idempotency result, and outbox without orphans.
The original 10x50 hosted matrix and an independent aligned-key 120-attempt batch each produce exactly one winner; the rotation split-brain defect is assessed under AC-017.
Same-request replay, 120-way same-operation replay, mismatch rejection, expiry, and keyed/domain-separated commitments behave safely.
The runtime role can directly write a complete manufactured lifecycle while the privileged rotation workload has no dedicated executable role.
New/duplicate conceptual responses match status, schema, size class, and next step and reveal no existing entity ID; HTTP timing is not applicable because Phase 1 exposes no transport endpoint.
Safe diagnostics and inspected artifacts contain operational causes without restricted identity/crypto values.
Conceptual outcomes map to stable Foundation Problem Details without introducing Phase 2 authentication contracts.
All 115 columns are inventoried; policy approval remains pre-production governance.
Retention, closure, crypto-erasure, tombstone, legal-hold, evidence deletion, and backup policy remain pre-production governance.
The implementation threat map claims controls that the adversarial probes disproved, including direct-lifecycle denial and safe rotation uniqueness.
All normalization, crypto, lifecycle, idempotency, redaction, event, and rotation unit/property tests pass.
Real PostgreSQL disproved the claimed direct-bypass denial, rotation split-brain safety, evidence coherence, and usable rotation-role matrix.
ADR-011/012 are accepted and linked without rewriting earlier ADR history.

The authoritative fresh implementation verification and hosted runs 34662427613 and 34663017247 are green. The audit checkout independently passed every local sub-gate except the external advisory fetch, which was unavailable twice and is corroborated by the hosted zero-advisory artifact.
The final adversarial audit is complete but failed; remediation and re-audit are required before Phase 1 can close.
